description: This file provides tools for comparing sequences of strings and generating textual diffs, including classes and functions for sequence matching, computing differences, and producing unified diff outputs.

classes.name: SequenceMatcher
classes.description: A class for comparing sequences of strings to find matching blocks, compute differences, and generate diff operations.

classes.name: UnifiedDiff
classes.description: A structure representing parameters and data for generating unified diffs.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: A structure representing a contiguous matching subsequence between two sequences.

classes.name: OpCode
classes.description: A structure representing a diff operation (replace, delete, insert, equal) with indices.

methods.name: NewMatcher
methods.description: Creates a new SequenceMatcher with auto junk detection enabled.

methods.name: NewMatcherWithJunk
methods.description: Creates a new SequenceMatcher with custom junk detection and auto junk detection options.

methods.name: SetSeqs
methods.description: Sets both sequences to be compared.

methods.name: SetSeq1
methods.description: Sets the first sequence for comparison.

methods.name: SetSeq2
methods.description: Sets the second sequence for comparison.

methods.name: chainB
methods.description: Builds a mapping from sequence elements to indices, filtering junk and popular elements.

methods.name: findLongestMatch
methods.description: Finds the longest matching block between subsequences.

methods.name: GetMatchingBlocks
methods.description: Returns a list of matching subsequences.

methods.name: GetOpCodes
methods.description: Returns a list of diff operations to convert one sequence into another.

methods.name: GetGroupedOpCodes
methods.description: Returns grouped diff operations with context lines.

methods.name: Ratio
methods.description: Calculates a similarity ratio between sequences.

methods.name: QuickRatio
methods.description: Provides a quick upper bound estimate of the ratio.

methods.name: RealQuickRatio
methods.description: Provides a very fast upper bound estimate of the ratio.
